title: Board Redraw Modes And Logical Graph Layout
description: Generalize board layout simulation into Redraw modes: force-graph and hierarchical-tree share tick-based redraw plumbing; each accepts logical fixture nodes without required x,y (seed positions in WASM). Unify TS API and board play settings UI (shared vs per-mode params).
summary: Hierarchical tree layout uses `direction` (downwards, upwards, right, left) instead of orientation; Rust maps rank axis to x/y; play settings Select lists all four; aliases up/down accepted in WASM.
